conventions.name: package-has-manifest
conventions.description: Every workspace under packages/ is a directory that ships a package.json manifest.

conventions.name: package-has-entrypoint
conventions.description: Every workspace exposes a src/index.ts entrypoint. Epoch.CLI is the deliberate exception: it ships CLI entrypoints (src/cli.ts, src/cli-git.ts) instead of a barrel.

conventions.name: sample-has-manifest
conventions.description: Every sample app under samples/ is a directory that ships a package.json manifest.
